title: Prepare an order-to-billing review list
reason: A proposed mock turns fictional work-order notes into a list of missing closure details for a clerk to check before billing; it does not update official records or issue invoices. Proposed narrow test: The separate invoice-review lead overlaps on invoice checking, but this notice additionally names work-order closure; its narrow closure-list task remains distinct. No attached reference supports work-order status rules. Five-criterion mean 4.4 is below the threshold of 6; no validated AI-service demand.
